name: Highlands Mill
summary: Highlands Mill is a timber operation tucked away in the western woods of the Arathi Highlands. Positioned to harvest the valuable wood of the region, the mill serves as a strategic source of lumber for nearby Stromgarde Keep and the broader struggle over the highland territories.

sections.title: Timber of the Highlands
sections.body: Nestled in the western reaches of the Arathi Highlands, the Highlands Mill cuts and processes timber vital to military fortified sites, principally Stromgarde Keep. As the surrounding basin remains locked in contest between the League of Arathor, the Forsaken-backed Defilers, and various local predators, secure raw materials like lumber are indispensable. The operation must constantly contend with dense groves harboring wildkin, ferocious bears, and roving scouting parties.

faq.q: What is the Highlands Mill used for?
faq.answer: Highlands Mill is a logging outpost tasked with processing timber in the western Arathi Highlands. Its wood is a vital logistical resource, particularly for rebuilding and reinforcing fortifications around Stromgarde Keep.

faq.q: What threats lurk around the mill?
faq.answer: The dense surrounding woods host dangerous beasts, including vicious black bears and territorial owlbeasts, as well as scouting parties from hostile factions contesting the highlands.

faq.q: Why is lumber so contested in Arathi?
faq.answer: Wood is the lifeblood of campaign logistics. Without a steady supply of lumber, neither side can maintain siege engines, repair stone-and-timber battlements, or secure the disputed frontier.

angles.text: The Alliance relies heavily on raw lumber to reinforce Stromgarde's remnants and fortify frontline positions across the contested highlands.
Denying timber to Stromgarde weakens the human foothold in Arathi, giving the Horde and its Forsaken allies greater leverage across the basin.
